f32_1_5 = 0000c03f
f64_minus_2_25 = 00000000000002c0

# strings and bytes: u32 length, then the bytes

bytes_00_ff_10 = 0300000000ff10

# arrays: u32 count, then the elements

# optionals: a bool, then the value when true
